## Positioning

Carlos builds backend and platform systems for products that need to scale, integrate, and keep working. Recent work includes SaaS platforms, hotel provider connectivity, travel quoting systems, cloud infrastructure, event-driven workflows, and AI-enabled workflow automation.

## Primary Case Studies

### Sócrates

Curriculum-grounded exam generation for Dominican teachers. The platform transforms official MINERD teaching sequences into editable, print-ready DOCX exams using document retrieval, OCR, structured extraction, and grounded AI generation.

Key signals:

- Real user workflow for Dominican teachers
- Official curriculum grounding through MINERD teaching sequences
- Document retrieval, OCR, AI extraction, structured extraction
- Editable DOCX output
- Exam preparation reduced from about 40 minutes to 10 minutes for advanced Word users
- Exam preparation reduced from about 90 minutes to 15 minutes for lower digital-skill users after learning the software

Project URL: https://socrates.xavely.com

### Hotel Connectivity & Quote Performance

Travel-tech backend work for hotel provider integrations and quote performance. Work included provider integrations, rate and availability synchronization, exchange-rate paths, promotions paths, and quote-service performance improvements.

Project URL: https://pricetravel.com

### Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform APIs

Backend platform work for SaaS products connecting insurers, service providers, agents, and internal operations. Work included API design, multi-tenant product foundations, storage integrations, notifications, and workflow infrastructure.

Project URL: https://sektor.app/

### Real-Time Streaming API

Real-time data backend tracking 128 roulette tables through browser automation and emitting deduplicated updates over WebSockets.
